podcast.body: A collaboration with Brian Eno that adapted their 70s Berlin techniques to 90s industrial rock, with its lead single "The Hearts Filthy Lesson" making the modern rock top 20. Fans noted its resemblance to Trent Reznor's Nine Inch Nails, solidifying Bowie's exploration of heavier electronic sounds in the grunge era. "Three years later, Brian Eno reunited with Bowie for the 1995 album Outside, which adapted their 70s Berlin techniques to 90s industrial rock."
